newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf refinery strike continues - union.
newsitem.headline: Elf refinery strike continues - union.

text.p: French union CFDT said a four-day-old strike was continuing on Monday at three Elf Aquitaine refineries in France.
A refinery official at one of the plants, at Donges in western France, confirmed the plant was still shut down but Elf spokesmen were not immediately available to confirm the status of the other two.
Strikes started at the Donges, Grandpuits and Feyzin refineries last Wednesday and Thursday in a dispute over planned job cuts.
"It has been extended," a spokesman for the union's petroleum workers' branch said on Monday.
The Donges refinery official said the next deadline for deciding whether to extend the strike was Tuesday morning.
There had been little progress in talks between management and unions over the weekend, he said.
The three plants represent all of Elf's domestic refining capacity, he said.

Donges, in western France, is the biggest of the three with distillation capacity of 211,000 barrels per day (bpd), according to Elf figures. Feyzin, on the outskirts of Lyon, has 120,000 bpd capacity and Grandpuits near Paris is 95,000 bpd.
